svg.title: 03 / THEIR SUM
svg.desc: The color field evaluates cos(k rA) plus cos(k rB) directly on a uniform grid. Cyan marks positive values, brass negative values, and dark ink values near zero. Thin curves show zero and plus/minus 1.2 level contours. This static illustrative scalar study has no physical decay, time stepping, or calibration.
svg.text: s(x, y) = cos(k rA) + cos(k rB)
